name: XtremeAir XA42 Sbach 342
summary: Modern German all-composite unlimited aerobatic monoplane designed by Sbach; it is flown in competition and airshows.

wings: Low-set cantilever carbon-composite wing with long ailerons
engines: Six-cylinder Lycoming AEIO-580 in a tight cowl
fuselage: Tandem cockpits under a long bubble canopy
Fixed spring gear with a tailwheel
tail: Large rudder and tailplane on a sleek tapering rear fuselage

tellTales: Low-wing aerobatic taildragger with a long tandem bubble canopy
Smooth all-composite fuselage with a three-blade prop
Tight cowl over a six-cylinder engine and fixed spring gear

confusedWith.howToTell: The Extra 300 has a fabric-covered rear fuselage and a different cowl; the XA42 is smooth carbon composite throughout.
The Edge 540 is usually a single-seater with a short canopy; the XA42 has two seats under a long canopy.
